sylph_k.help_text: Value of k. Only k = 21, 31 are currently supported.

sylph_tax_metadata.help_text: Path to the sylph-tax metadata TSV to use for taxprof.

genome_path_prefix.help_text: Path to prefix sylph references in sylph database paths to make them resolvable.

sylph_estimate_unknown.help_text: Estimate proportion of classified sequences where the sum of Sequence_abundance column is the percentage of classified reads.

sylph_read_seq_id.help_text: Estimated percentage identity of your sequences (i.e. 100 - error percent). 99.5 is recommended for Illumina reads. Set this parameter to false to enable sylph to provide its own estimate for percentage identity. See Sylph documentation for additional information.

bracken_classification_level.help_text: Taxonomic rank to analyze for Bracken (Options: 'D', 'P', 'C', 'O', 'F', 'G', 'S'). Cannot check the accuracy of classification at species level if bracken classification level is not set to 'S' (species)

read_len.help_text: Expected length of reads in the sample
